violations.message: RiskReport must link at least one evidence id.

input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic remote monitoring center reported that the patient suffered a confirmed embolic stroke temporally linked to an unflagged rapid-ventricular-response atrial fibrillation episode, confirmed by hospital emergency response records. The only artifact filed against this report is an unrelated code-review diff that predates this device version and does not describe the event.

risk_report.rationale: A patient suffered a confirmed embolic stroke temporally linked to an unflagged rapid-ventricular-response atrial fibrillation episode. This represents realized serious harm and potential broad deployed-population exposure to a serious risk, triggering obligations under EU MDR Annex I, Chapter II, Section 17.1 regarding electronic programmable systems ensuring repeatability, reliability, and performance in line with intended use, and Section 17.2 concerning the software development lifecycle and cybersecurity. The incident also requires review under 21 CFR § 820.10(c) due to the device being automated with computer software. While a code-review diff predating the device version is present, it's unrelated and doesn’t describe the event; therefore, further investigation is needed to determine the root cause of the missed detection. The presence of confidence score logs (ARTIFACT-TESTLOG-2025A, ARTIFACT-TESTLOG-2029A) suggests a potential systemic issue with device performance that warrants immediate field safety action.
